lines.t: When one is born into this world
The child and the mother suffer the pains
of childbirth until the birth is complete in the same way those born of the Spirit shall suffer
travail for they are not yet separated from their flesh or this world in which they continually
4 So then being born again is the process by which you are restored in the image of God, a continual washing, until you come into glory, says the Lord.
